Pillow 12.0.0 — https://pypi.org/project/Pillow/12.0.0/

These are unmodified upstream wheels for CPython 3.12 and 3.13 on Linux
x86_64, tagged manylinux_2_27 and manylinux_2_28 (glibc 2.27 or newer).
Their upstream license notices are included inside each wheel.

Network fetching was blocked during this build. Both wheels were fetched
in this session with `pip download --no-index --find-links` from a local
cache of previously downloaded upstream wheels.

SHA-256:

- CPython 3.12: `b87843e225e74576437fd5b6a4c2205d422754f84a06942cfaf1dc32243e45a8`
- CPython 3.13: `f4f1231b7dec408e8670264ce63e9c71409d9583dd21d32c163e25213ee2a344`

The three bundled Liberation Sans TTFs were copied, unmodified, from
`/usr/share/fonts/truetype/liberation/` during this session. Their copyright,
SIL Open Font License and upstream source are recorded in `fonts/LICENSE.txt`.
